optimized_sql:
WITH
d1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 4
      AND d_year = 1999
),
d2 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
      AND d_year = 1999
),
d3 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
      AND d_year = 1999
),
ss_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN d1
      ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
),
sr_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        sr.sr_net_loss
    FROM store_returns AS sr
    JOIN d2
      ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
),
cs_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales AS cs
    JOIN d3
      ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
),
fact AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        max(ss.ss_net_profit) AS ss_net_profit,
        max(sr.sr_net_loss) AS sr_net_loss,
        max(cs.cs_net_profit) AS cs_net_profit
    FROM ss_filtered AS ss
    JOIN sr_filtered AS sr
      ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
     AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
     AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    JOIN cs_filtered AS cs
      ON sr.sr_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
     AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    GROUP BY
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_item_desc,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    max(fact.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
    max(fact.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
    max(fact.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM fact
JOIN store AS s
  ON s.s_store_sk = fact.ss_store_sk
JOIN item AS i
  ON i.i_item_sk = fact.ss_item_sk
GROUP BY
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_item_desc,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name
ORDER BY
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_item_desc,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name
LIMIT 100
